versions.changelog:
Initial release of xiaohongshu-note-acquire — a command-line tool for structured Xiaohongshu note data acquisition.

- Enables keyword-based search, high-like/comment/collect sorting, date range filtering, and up to 10,000 notes per fetch.
- Supports retrieval of note content, comments, and creator posts via different commands and input types.
- Outputs data in structured format for easy analysis, research, and content strategy.
- Designed for secure use (no account login), large-scale scraping, and compatibility with popular platforms and AI agents.
- Requires GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN for data access.
